# gtm_accounts (Data Source)

Lists all GTM Accounts that a user has access to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all_pages` (Boolean) Follow next_page_token until every page has been retrieved. Defaults to true.
- `include_google_tags` (Boolean) Also retrieve accounts associated with Google Tag when true.
- `page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

### Read-Only

- `account_json` (String, Sensitive) List of GTM Accounts that a user has access to.
- `next_page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.
